_about: OI-67 slice 4 (WI-531): the split. One object per registry ACTION. `new` rows are minted from the watermark (IF=144 -> IF-145 onward, in this order); `edit` rows change cells on an existing row; `delete` rows collapse into the row named in `into`. Every `far` list marked MEASURE is the worker's to measure from the code and report; a stated list is the coordinator's reading and the worker confirms or corrects it. `body_home` is where the `Contract IF-###:` body goes and whose `Contracts:` marker must carry the id. Channels: cli | exit-code | stdout | file | call | env | git | bytes.

rows.why: IF-127 collapses into this row: same owner surface (load_registries + reattest_model), differing only in requestor. Merge IF-127's body clauses (reached through load_registries; an EMPTY model is a real answer, handed back to refuse on) into IF-075's body; drop IF-127 from the marker and delete its body.
